package control

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"testing"

	"github.com/n0madic/go-openvpn/internal/proto"
)

func TestDetectLegacyOpenSSLVector(t *testing.T) {
	// Independently generated with OpenSSL 3 TLS1-PRF, digest MD5-SHA1.
	var client, server proto.KeyMethod2
	for i := range client.PreMaster { client.PreMaster[i] = byte(i) }
	for i := range client.Random1 {
		client.Random1[i] = byte(i+1); server.Random1[i] = byte(i+33)
		client.Random2[i] = byte(i+65); server.Random2[i] = byte(i+97)
	}
	want := ""
	got := DeriveLegacyDataKeys(client, server, 0x0102030405060708, 0x1112131415161718)
	if hex.EncodeToString(got[:]) != want { t.Fatal("legacy data keys differ from independent OpenSSL vector") }
	changed := DeriveLegacyDataKeys(client, server, 0x0102030405060709, 0x1112131415161718)
	if got == changed { t.Fatal("client session ID was not bound into keys") }
}

func TestDetectNegotiatedExporter(t *testing.T) {
	for _, value := range []string{"key-derivation tls-ekm", "cipher AES-256-GCM,protocol-flags cc-exit tls-ekm,tun-mtu 1500"} {
		if !NegotiatedTLSExporter(value) { t.Fatal("authenticated exporter flag ignored") }
	}
	for _, value := range []string{"", "cipher AES-256-GCM", "echo tls-ekm", "protocol-flags no-tls-ekm", "key-derivation other"} {
		if NegotiatedTLSExporter(value) { t.Fatal("unnegotiated exporter selected") }
	}
}
